classification.difficultyReason: Take the positive square root of the constant to find the radius, then mark the origin centre and symmetric axis intercepts using the taught sketching procedure.

content.prompt: Sketch these circles showing the centre and all intercepts.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r^{2}&=49\\r&=7\end{align*}$$
The centre is $(0,0)$. Mark $(7,0)$, $(-7,0)$, $(0,7)$ and $(0,-7)$, then sketch the circle through them.
